description: Lethonion wears a cream long tunic with a small slit neckline and gold geometric borders beneath a deep purple long outer coat. A burgundy patterned shoulder mantle with gold edging is fixed by a round red-centered brooch. Wide cuffs carry intricate narrow woven borders. A broad brown decorated belt and hanging metal fittings define the waist. Dark trousers and tall brown leather-like boots cover the lower legs. Cloth is substantial and opaque, with exact fibers uncertain. Sleeves reach the wrists and jewelry is restrained. No headgear, armor, weapon or crown is visible.
